moments.title: Lulu turns 78!

angles.name: Scottish Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to Scotland's own powerhouse, Lulu! From 'Shout' to Eurovision, what's your favourite Lulu track?

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Still got that incredible voice! Celebrating the amazing Lulu on her 78th birthday. Which era of her music do you love most?

moments.title: Bonfire Night 2026
moments.blurb: Bonfire Night, commemorating the Gunpowder Plot, takes place on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays happening this weekend.

angles.name: Firework Safety
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is Thursday! If you're heading to a display or having your own, remember to stay safe and follow the firework code. What are your plans?

angles.name: London Displays
angles.copy: Londoners, get ready for Bonfire Night! Alexandra Palace and Battersea Park have huge firework and drone festivals happening this weekend. Where are you watching from?

moments.title: Bryan Adams turns 67!

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: It's Bryan Adams' 67th birthday on Thursday! What's the one song you always turn up loud when it comes on?

angles.name: Singalong Anthems
angles.copy: From 'Run To You' to 'Heaven', Bryan Adams gave us so many anthems. Happy 67th birthday to the rock icon this Thursday!

angles.name: Cymru Rugby

angles.name: Principality Stadium
angles.copy: Principality Stadium is set for a big one this Saturday as Wales face Japan. Who are you backing for the first game of the Nations Championship?

moments.title: Joni Mitchell turns 83!

angles.name: Folk Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the incomparable Joni Mitchell this Saturday! Her songwriting shaped generations. What's your favourite track of hers?

angles.name: Influential Artist
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Joni Mitchell, who turns 83 on November 7th. Her music is truly 'beyond category'.

moments.title: Lorde turns 30!

angles.name: Pop Superstar

angles.name: Decade of Hits
angles.copy: From a teenage sensation to a seasoned artist, Lorde celebrates her 30th birthday on November 7th. What's your go-to Lorde track?

moments.title: Remembrance Sunday 2026
moments.blurb: Remembrance Sunday will be observed on November 8th, with ceremonies across the UK honouring those who have served and sacrificed.

angles.name: Remembering Sacrifice
angles.copy: This Sunday, November 8th, is Remembrance Sunday. We pause to honour the service and sacrifice of our Armed Forces, veterans and their families. #RemembranceSunday

angles.name: Poppy Appeal
angles.copy: As Remembrance Sunday approaches, show your support for the Poppy Appeal. The Field of Remembrance at Westminster Abbey is open from Nov 5-15.

moments.title: Bonnie Raitt turns 77!

angles.name: Blues-Rock Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Bonnie Raitt this Sunday! A true guitar and vocal legend. What's your favourite Bonnie Raitt track?

angles.name: Timeless Talent
angles.copy: Celebrating Bonnie Raitt's 77th birthday on November 8th. Her powerful voice and slide guitar work are simply iconic.

moments.title: Remembrance Day 2026
moments.blurb: Remembrance Day, also known as Armistice Day, is observed annually on November 11th, marking the end of hostilities of World War I.

angles.name: Two-Minute Silence
angles.copy: On Wednesday, November 11th, we observe Remembrance Day. At the eleventh hour, we pause for two minutes of silence to remember those who died in the line of duty. #RemembranceDay

angles.name: Lest We Forget
angles.copy: As the nation prepares for Remembrance Day on November 11th, wear your poppy with pride to honour the fallen and support veterans.

moments.title: Wales vs New Zealand: Nations Championship

angles.name: Big Rugby Clash
angles.copy: A huge one for Welsh rugby next Saturday! Wales take on the mighty All Blacks in Cardiff. Can they pull off a historic victory? #WALvNZ

angles.name: Principality Showdown
angles.copy: The atmosphere will be electric at Principality Stadium next Saturday as Wales host New Zealand. Who's got their tickets ready?

angles.name: Ant & Dec Are Back
